study.comment:
Study name, written by `pkdb format` from the folder name. Do not edit.
Example: Guo2016

name.comment:
Unique subject name. The root group is `all`.
Example: all
Required

parent.comment:
Name of the parent group. Empty only for `all`.
Example: all

count.comment:
Number of subjects. A count of 1 makes the row an individual; any other count, or an empty cell, makes it a group.
Example: 12

source.comment:
Paper table or figure the row comes from, such as `Tab1` or `Fig2A`, or `Text` for the article text. Except for `Text`, the image `<study>_<source>.png` must exist.
Example: Tab1

study.comment:
Study name, written by `pkdb format` from the folder name. Do not edit.
Example: Guo2016

source.comment:
Paper table or figure the row comes from, such as `Tab1` or `Fig2A`, or `Text` for the article text. Except for `Text`, the image `<study>_<source>.png` must exist.
Example: Tab1

name.comment:
Unique intervention name, referenced from the `interventions` columns of other tables.
Example: D1
Required

subjects.comment:
Subject that the dose statistics describe, for body-weight-adjusted doses with `sd`, `min` or `max`. Usually empty.
Example: all

measurement.comment:
Kind of intervention from the vocabulary, such as `dosing`, `qualitative dosing` or `fasting`.
Example: dosing
Required

calculation.comment:
How the central value was obtained, from the vocabulary. `unspecified summary` marks a central value whose statistic the publication does not state; enter it in `mean`.
Example: unspecified summary

substance.comment:
Substance from the vocabulary.
Example: caffeine

tissue.comment:
Tissue or matrix from the vocabulary.
Example: plasma

method.comment:
Analytical method from the vocabulary.
Example: HPLC

choice.comment:
Categorical value of a categorical intervention, such as `Y` for `fasting`.
Example: Y

route.comment:
Administration route from the vocabulary.
Example: oral

form.comment:
Administration form from the vocabulary.
Example: tablet

application.comment:
Application from the vocabulary, such as `single dose`.
Example: single dose

time.comment:
Time of the first administration in `time_unit`. An irregular schedule is a `;`-separated list such as `0;12;40`.
Example: 0

time_end.comment:
End of a continuous administration in `time_unit`.
Example: 2

time_unit.comment:
Unit of `time`, `time_end` and `interval`, or `NR` when the publication does not report it.
Example: h

count.comment:
Number of subjects the dose statistics describe. Usually empty.
Example: 12

mean.comment:
Dose. A fixed dose is entered as its value, such as `100` with unit `mg`.
Example: 100

se.comment:
Standard error of the mean.
Example: 0.2

cv.comment:
Coefficient of variation in percent.
Example: 24

gsd.comment:
Geometric standard deviation as a dimensionless factor of at least 1.
Example: 1.3

gcv.comment:
Geometric coefficient of variation in percent.
Example: 26

error_bar.comment:
Digitized end of an error bar on the value axis, in `unit`. The statistic named in `error_type` is derived from it.
Example: 3.6

error_type.comment:
Statistic the error bar shows: `sd`, `se` or `gsd`.
Example: sd
